H8500.def: or tuwkkiy {took-kee'}; probably of foreign derivation; some imported creature, probably a peacock:--peacock.

H8501.et: from an unused root meaning to dissever, i.e. crush
H8501.def: from an unused root meaning to dissever, i.e. crush:--deceitful.

H8503.def: from «03615»; completion; by implication, an extremity:--end, perfect(-ion).

H8504.def: probably for «07827»; the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith:--blue.

H8505.def: a primitive root; to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test):--bear up, direct, be ((un-))equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh.

H8507.def: the same as «08506»; Token, a place in Palestine:--Tochen.

H8509.et: apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass
H8509.def: apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass; a wrapper or robe:--garment.

H8510.def: by contraction from «08524»; a mound:--heap, × strength.

H8511.def: a primitive root; to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate:--be bent, hang (in doubt).

H8512.def: from «08510» and «024»; mound of green growth; Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea:--Tel-abib.

H8515.def: or Tlassar {tel-as-sar'}; of foreign derivation; Telassar, a region of Assyria:--Telassar.

H8518.def: a primitive root; to suspend (especially to gibbet):--hang (up).

H8519.et: from (03885) in the sense of obstinacy
H8519.def: or tlunnah {tel-oon-naw'}; from «03885» in the sense of obstinacy; a grumbling:--murmuring.

H8520.et: probably from an unused root meaning to dissever
H8520.def: probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; Telach, an Israelite:--Telah.

H8521.def: from «08510» and the feminine of «02798»; mound of workmanship; Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia:--Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.

H8524.def: a primitive root; to pile up, i.e. elevate:--eminent. Compare «02048».

H8525.et: from an unused root meaning to accumulate
H8525.def: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; a bank or terrace:--furrow, ridge.

H8526.def: from «08525»; ridged; Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian:--Talmai.

H8528.def: from «08510» and «04417»; mound of salt; Tel-Melach, a place in Babylonia:--Tel-melah.

H8529.def: a denominative from «08438»; to crimson, i.e. dye that color:--X scarlet.

H8530.et: from an unused root meaning to tower
H8530.def: feminine from an unused root meaning to tower; something tall, i.e. (plural collective) slenderness:--armoury.

H8532.def: (Aramaic) masculine tlathah (Aramaic) {tel-aw-thaw'}; or tlatha (Aramaic) {tel-aw-thaw'}; corresponding to «07969»; three or third:--third, three.

H8534.et: by reduplication, from (08524) through the idea of vibration
H8534.def: by reduplication, from «08524» through the idea of vibration; a trailing bough (as pendulous):--bushy.

H8535.def: from «08552»; complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear:--coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.

H8536.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08033»; there:--X thence, there, × where.

H8537.def: from «08552»; completeness; figuratively, prosperity; usually (morally) innocence:--full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture. See «08550».

H8539.def: a primitive root; to be in consternation:--be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

H8540.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «08539»; a miracle:--wonder.

H8542.def: of uncertain derivation; Tammuz, a Phoenician deity:--Tammuz.

H8543.def: or tmol {tem-ole'}; probably for «0865»; properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or (with «08032») day before yesterday:--+ before (-time), + these (three) days, + heretofore, + time past, yesterday.

H8544.def: or tmunah {tem-oo-naw'}; from «04327»; something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as a shape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor):--image, likeness, similitude.

H8547.def: of uncertain derivation; Temach, one of the Nethinim:--Tamah, Thamah.

H8548.et: from an unused root meaning to stretch
H8548.def: from an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice:--alway(-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, ((n-))ever(-more), perpetual.

H8549.def: from «08552»; entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth:--without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

H8550.def: plural of «08537»; perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth:--Thummim.

H8551.def: a primitive root; to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close:--(take, up-)hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).

H8552.def: a primitive root; to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive (as follows):--accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-)ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, × be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

H8553.def: from «04487»; a portion assigned; Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine:--Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.

H8554.def: patrial from «08553»; a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah:--Timnite.

H8555.def: from «04513»; restraint; Timna, the name of two Edomites:--Timna, Timnah.

H8556.def: or Timnath Cerach {tim-nath seh'-rakh}; from «08553» and «02775»; portion of (the) sun; Timnath-Cheres, a place in Palestine:--Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.

H8558.et: from an unused root meaning to be erect
H8558.def: from an unused root meaning to be erect; a palm tree:--palm (tree).

H8559.def: the same as «08558»; Tamar, the name of three women and a place:--Tamar.

H8560.def: from the same root as «08558»; a palm trunk:--palm tree.

H8561.def: (plural o or (feminine) timmorah (singular and plural) {tim-mo-raw'}; from the same root as «08558»; (arch.) a palm-like pilaster (i.e. umbellate):--palm tree.

H8562.def: or tamruq {tam-rook'}; or tamriyq {tam-reek'}; from «04838»; properly, a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery for the bath; figuratively, a detergent:--X cleanse, (thing for) purification(-fying).

H8563.def: from «04843»; bitterness (plural as collective):--X most bitter(-ly).

H8564.def: from the same root as «08558»; an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board):--high heap.

H8565.et: from an unused root probably meaning to elongate
H8565.def: from an unused root probably meaning to elongate; a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal):--dragon, whale. Compare «08577».

H8566.def: a primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot):--hire.

H8567.et: a primitive root [identical with (08566) through the idea of attributing honour]
H8567.def: a primitive root (identical with «08566» through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate:--lament, rehearse.

H8568.def: probably feminine of «08565»; a female jackal:--dragon.

H8569.def: from «05106»; alienation; by implication, enmity:--breach of promise, occasion.

H8571.et: perhaps from the same as (0594) through the idea of protraction
H8571.def: perhaps from the same as «0594» through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, i.e. extremity:--tip.

H8573.def: from «05130»; a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings:--offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8575.def: or tanchum {tan-khoom'}; and (feminine) tanchuwmah {tan-khoo-maw'}; from «05162»; compassion, solace:--comfort, consolation.

H8577.def: or tanniym (Ezek. 29:3) {tan-neem'}; intensive from the same as «08565»; a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal:--dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8580.def: from «05395»; properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen:--mole, swan.

H8581.def: a primitive root; to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest:--(make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), × utterly.

H8582.def: a primitive root; to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both:--(cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

H8583.def: or Tomiy {to'-ee}; from «08582»; error, Tou or Toi, a Syrian king:--Toi, Tou.

H8584.def: from «05749»; attestation, i.e. a precept, usage:--testimony.

H8585.def: from «05927»; a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound):--conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.

H8586.def: from «05953»; caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant:--babe, delusion.

H8587.def: from «05956»; a secret:--thing that is hid, secret.

H8588.def: or taanug {tah-an-oog'}; and (feminine) taeanugah {tah-ah-oog-aw'}; from «06026»; luxury:--delicate, delight, pleasant.

H8590.def: or Tanak {tah-nawk'}; of uncertain derivation; Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine:--Taanach, Tanach.

H8591.def: a primitive root; to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat:--deceive, misuse.

H8593.def: from «06168»; a knife or razor (as making bare): also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty):--(pen-)knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8594.def: from «06148»; suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge:--+ hostage.

H8597.def: or tiphereth {tif-eh'-reth}; from «06286»; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively):--beauty(- iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), hono; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively):--beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

H8598.def: from «05301»; an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.):--apple (tree). See also «01054».

H8599.def: the same as «08598»; Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite:--Tappuah.
